description: This file contains helper functions for testing the behavior of the 'git read-tree' command with options like dry-run and update. The functions verify that the command succeeds or fails as expected without altering the index or work tree, comparing pre- and post-command states.

methods.name: read_tree_must_succeed
methods.description: Ensures that 'git read-tree' with given arguments succeeds without changing the index state.

methods.name: read_tree_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that 'git read-tree' with given arguments fails without changing the index state.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Ensures that 'git read-tree' with update options succeeds without changing the index or work tree.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that 'git read-tree' with update options fails without changing the index or work tree.
